topics.title: Write suitable pieces of advice for a friend whose teenage son is behaving badly.
guiding_questions: What is the problem with the son?
How can she talk to her son?
What is the best advice you can give?
topics.sample_essay: I advise you to talk to your son calmly. He should feel your love. You should not shout at him. Listen to him. He is supposed to study every day. You should help him study. Give him free time. He will trust you more. This will make him a better student now and later too.

topics.title: Write about your friend who always cheats in the exam. Give some advice.
guiding_questions: What will happen if he continues?
What is your advice to him?
topics.sample_essay: I think cheating is bad. It is wrong because you learn nothing. If you continue, you will fail later. I advise you to study every day. It is better to ask your teacher for help. You should read your lessons. I recommend working with a friend. You will feel proud of yourself when you pass.
